pages.title: Bubble Rush 2
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Fire outward from the center in Bubble Rush 2. Match at least three bubbles of one color and cut their connections to the walls so unsupported groups fall. Watch the directional arrows and clear the formation before new rows move too close.

pages.title: Color Screw Rescue Puzzle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Plan a rescue through fastener puzzles in Color Screw Rescue Puzzle. Examine the colored screws and choose which ones to remove from each arrangement. Work through the changing layouts by considering what each removal opens next.

pages.title: Pottery Master
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Shape a clay vessel in Pottery Master. Use the sculpting tools to adjust its form and refine the surface before applying colors. Experiment with the available techniques to turn the plain clay into a finished piece of pottery.

pages.title: Marble Run - Ultimate Race!
pages.creator: Sunday GmbH
pages.description: Roll against rivals in Marble Run - Ultimate Race! Steer your marble through physics-based courses, dodge traps, and try to push opponents beyond the edge. Stay on the track through races and knockout rounds while working toward new marble skins.

pages.title: Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Fight assigned roles in Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels. Enter one-on-one or team matches with up to four players per side, then use your role's abilities to eliminate the opposing team. Earn rewards, gain levels, and unlock skins from successful contests.

pages.title: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Create a small character world in Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls. Choose outfits, accessories, and hairstyles for the dolls, then arrange backgrounds, props, and stickers around them. Combine the fashion choices with a scene that suits the finished characters.

pages.title: Mosquito Bite 3d
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Sneak in for a bite in Mosquito Bite 3d. Fly toward the human target and find an opening to attack the required body area. Watch for attempts to swat the mosquito as you complete each biting task.

pages.title: Magic Sorting
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Clear objects from portals in Magic Sorting. Drag matching items into rows of three, then remove the entire collection to finish the level. A wand can eliminate pairs and a magnifying glass highlights matches, while earned points unlock visual customizations.

pages.title: Squid Challenge: Play to Survive
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Complete timed survival trials in Squid Challenge: Play to Survive. Follow the rules of each round and use taps, swipes, or held inputs to carry out its task. Avoid mistakes that eliminate the character as you progress into harder challenges.

pages.title: Fashion World Simulator
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Prepare a model for international runways in Fashion World Simulator. Choose makeup, clothing, and decorative details to build a competition look. Compare styles and take part in the voting as you pursue a win.

pages.title: Tie-Dye Explosion of Color
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style Kaylee and Marie in Tie-Dye Explosion of Color. Choose makeup, clothes, and accessories around vivid tie-dye patterns. Mix the available shades and pieces to give each friend a separate colorful outfit.

pages.title: Puppy Merge
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Combine falling dogs in Puppy Merge. Drag identical puppies together to create larger ones and keep the group inside the arena. If a puppy slips beyond the box, try to catch it and return it before the game ends.

pages.title: Blue Mushroom Cat Run
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Chase a gold thief in Blue Mushroom Cat Run. Guide the cat through obstacle-filled routes ranging from beaches to neon city streets. Keep the pursuit going as new worlds and course sections become available.

pages.title: Kings and Queens Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Help Princess Bella through matching boards in Kings and Queens Match. Swap pieces into groups of at least three and meet the level's objective before the moves run out. Use royal bombs, hammers, and wands to help clear difficult arrangements.

pages.title: Frozen Winter Mania
pages.creator: Immanitas Ent. GmbH
pages.description: Clear icy gems against the clock in Frozen Winter Mania. Form rows or columns of at least three identical pieces and finish the board before time expires. Use the available power-ups when ordinary matches leave an awkward section.

pages.title: Live Avatar Maker: Girls
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Design an animated portrait in Live Avatar Maker: Girls. Adjust the skin tone and the shape of facial features, then choose hair, makeup, clothes, and accessories. Color sliders let you refine individual details of the character.

pages.title: Coffee Master Idle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Run a growing café in Coffee Master Idle. Prepare drinks, serve customers, and keep the shop clean while earning money for the business. Hire staff, add drive-through service, and open new areas as the coffee operation expands.

pages.title: SUV Snow Driving 3d
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Drive over winter terrain in SUV Snow Driving 3d. Steer the off-road vehicle through bumpy snow-covered routes while maintaining control. Use WASD or the arrow keys to handle the SUV's direction and pace.

pages.title: Black Friday Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Match shopping items in Black Friday Mahjong. Pair tiles showing the same picture even when their sizes or outlines differ. Clear the full playing field, using hints and shuffles if the remaining arrangement is difficult to solve.

pages.title: Color Shooting
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Use the correct colors for your shots in Color Shooting. Watch the colored balls and make the matching shooting choice with the mouse. Keep responding accurately through the endless challenge to improve your score.

pages.title: Happy Lamb
pages.creator: 南京中琦网络科技有限公司
pages.description: Collect matching pictures in Happy Lamb. Select sets of three identical images to remove them from the holding tray. Clear every picture while keeping the seven available tray spaces from filling with unmatched pieces.

pages.title: Soccer Free Kick
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Aim around defensive barriers in Soccer Free Kick. Choose a team and swipe the ball toward the goal, curving its path when necessary. Find a shooting route past the obstacles in each level to build your goal total.

pages.title: Get Ready With Me Summer Picnic
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare four friends for an outing in Get Ready With Me Summer Picnic. Choose looks for Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet before they leave for their break. Explore the available wardrobe options to finish each girl's picnic outfit.

pages.title: Drift Car Extreme Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Practice controlled slides in Drift Car Extreme Simulator. Accelerate a performance car, use the separate handbrake to initiate drifts, and manage the steering through turns. Develop a feel for holding a slide while exploring the driving environment.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Cats & Kitten
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Assemble feline pictures in Jigsaw Puzzle Cats & Kitten. Drag pieces into place and choose a difficulty from small layouts to boards with hundreds of pieces. Try the daily challenge to work toward special unlockable items.

pages.title: Wake Up the Box 2
pages.creator: IceStone
pages.description: Disturb sleeping blocks in Wake Up the Box 2. Place objects in the scene so their weight and movement wake the box. Work out how each added piece affects the structure, and restart with the space bar to try another arrangement.

pages.title: Car Wash With John 2
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Care for a vehicle in Car Wash With John 2. Choose one of five cars, clean and decorate it, then take the finished vehicle for a drive. Complete two laps before returning to try another car.

pages.title: Happy Fruits Match3
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Match fruit across an extended puzzle journey in Happy Fruits Match3. Swipe to form lines of at least three identical fruits and complete the board's challenges. Continue through more than a thousand levels and collect the available daily bonuses.

pages.title: Four Colors World Tour Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Empty your hand in Four Colors World Tour Multiplayer. Play a card matching the top card's color or number and use action cards to interrupt rivals. Press the one-card button before finishing, and choose computer opponents or a multiplayer match.

pages.title: Waterpark Slide Race
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Race above the ground in Waterpark Slide Race. Guide the runner along the course and use launch sections to fly toward the next landing. Steer back onto the route and reach the finish ahead of the other characters.

pages.title: Bubble Marble
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Pop matching groups in Bubble Marble. Aim a bubble into a cluster of at least three of the same color to remove it. Work through eighty levels and use the space bar on a keyboard to switch the offered bubble.

pages.title: Curvy Road
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Keep a rolling ball on a narrow course in Curvy Road. Follow the bends through the three-dimensional route and avoid slipping over an edge. Make controlled adjustments to extend the run and improve your high score.

pages.title: Tennis Open 2021
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Compete across four major tournaments in Tennis Open 2021. Practice first in training mode, then beat opponents to win rewards and improve the player. Take the championships in Australia, France, Britain, and America to pursue the grand slam trophy.

pages.title: Ninja Warrior Shadow of Last Samurai
pages.creator: IzelgueGames
pages.description: Fight through medieval Japan in Ninja Warrior Shadow of Last Samurai. Use sword attacks and developing abilities against enemy fighters and bosses. Improve the shadow warrior's skills as you continue the revenge adventure.

pages.title: Wacky Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Choose when to sprint in Wacky Run. Guide the runner past moving hazards and try to keep ahead of the opponents. Recover from a setback and find another opening through the obstacle course to catch up.

pages.title: Tower Boxer
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Demolish a skyscraper with punches in Tower Boxer. Tap left or right to strike from that side and bring another section down. Switch positions before a balcony reaches your boxer to keep cutting the tower safely.

pages.title: Fairy Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Rebuild twelve fantasy pictures in Fairy Jigsaw. Choose an illustration of a winged fairy and move its pieces into the correct positions. Match the outfit and background details until each picture is complete.

pages.title: Cat Rolling
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Guide a rolling cat to an exit in Cat Rolling. Jump past obstacles to collect stars, and click mirrored objects to build a usable path. Gather the key so the door opens for the next level.

pages.title: Word Cross
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Build word answers in Word Cross. Select letters from the available set and use their combinations to complete the word puzzle. Compare different possible answers as you work through the remaining spaces.

pages.title: Sport Cars Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Paint a performance vehicle in Sport Cars Coloring. Choose a sports or racing car and apply colors to its outline. Erase a mistake when needed and save the finished picture after completing the design.

pages.title: Impossible City Car Stunt : Car Racing 2020
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Drive along elevated stunt routes in Impossible City Car Stunt : Car Racing 2020. Keep the car aligned through the difficult track sections and complete the driving missions. Work toward improved vehicles as you continue through the courses.

pages.title: Teddy Bubble Rescue
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Free little bears in Teddy Bubble Rescue. Aim colored shots to remove the bubbles around them and clear the rescue objective. Work through twenty levels, using angles and higher matches to remove larger sections of the formation.

pages.title: Hot Mexican Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Make matching rows in Hot Mexican Match 3. Arrange at least three identical themed pieces together to score and sustain the side meter. Keep finding combinations before the meter drops low enough to end the game.

pages.title: Schneekrieg io X
pages.creator: Kostenlose Spiele
pages.description: Roll a larger weapon in Schneekrieg io X. Gather snow until your ball is bigger than an opponent's, then push the rival over the arena's edge. Avoid icy patches that freeze the character and interrupt your movement.

pages.title: City Simulator
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Explore streets with different vehicles in City Simulator. Get into cars or motorcycles, drive around, and step out to take another ride. Use the camera, boost, handbrake, and optional manual gears to change how you handle the city drive.

pages.title: Robot Assembly
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Repair damaged machines in Robot Assembly. Act as the mechanic and put the robots' parts back into working arrangements after their battles. Use mouse or touch controls to complete the assembly puzzles.

pages.title: Cool Goal
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Send a football past defenders in Cool Goal. Slide to guide the shot around people and other obstacles that block the route. Reach the target to complete a level and take on another shooting arrangement.

pages.title: Skydom
pages.creator: The Pew Pew
pages.description: Compete through match-three boards in Skydom. Swap neighboring pieces of one color into groups of at least three and pursue each level's goal. Face other players or connect with friends for live matching contests across different puzzle settings.

pages.title: Crystal miner alpha
pages.creator: Lemonaz
pages.description: Earn money through taps in Crystal miner alpha. Click the crystal to collect income and increase your total. Keep returning to the mineral as you work through the game's crystal-mining clicker activity.

pages.title: Alien Hunter 2
pages.creator: Atmegame
pages.description: Eliminate extraterrestrial targets in Alien Hunter 2. Judge each shooting setup and try to take down an alien with one shot. Use keyboard or touch controls to aim your progress through the hunting challenge.

pages.title: Kill The Spy
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Bring down enemy agents in Kill The Spy. Shoot the right structural blocks so the collapsing pieces eliminate spies while leaving hostages unharmed. Use fewer moves for more stars and collect treasure to add to the score.

pages.title: Arkadium's Mahjong
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Clear traditional tile layouts in Arkadium's Mahjong. Select identical unblocked pairs and remove them from the board. Plan which exposed tiles to take so the next removals continue opening the stack.

pages.title: Christmas Tree Fun
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Chop a holiday tree in Christmas Tree Fun. Switch Santa between the trunk's sides and keep cutting without being hit by a branch. Build a higher score as the pace increases and unlock more characters.

pages.title: Santa Gifts Rush
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Plan a flight path in Santa Gifts Rush. Click each present to send Santa to it, collecting the full set while avoiding obstacles. After every gift is gathered, select Earth to bring him down for a safe landing.

pages.title: Santa Claus Adventures
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Gather colorful balls in Santa Claus Adventures. Guide Santa through twenty levels while keeping clear of the dangers along the route. Use the arrow keys for movement and A for an attack when needed.

pages.title: Ferrari 488 GT3 Evo Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six racing-car pictures in Ferrari 488 GT3 Evo Puzzle. Choose a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece layout for each image. Match the shapes and details until the complete car scene is restored.

pages.title: Fyfes
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: Create a row of five in Fyfes. Swipe or click a direction to bring colorful squares onto the board and arrange the orange blocks together. Plan each entry carefully, because the game ends when no further moves remain.

pages.title: Football Soccer League
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pass and shoot in Football Soccer League. Move a player with WASD, send the ball to a teammate with E or Z, and fire at goal with the space bar or X. Use passing routes to create opportunities for a shot.

pages.title: Panda Love2
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Help a panda reach the next portal in Panda Love2. Jump past spikes and other hurdles while collecting every coin on the stage. Once the coins are gone, enter the portal to continue the journey toward the panda's partner.

pages.title: Cartoon Candy Match3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Connect sweets in Cartoon Candy Match3. Join at least three matching cartoon candies to clear a group and continue the puzzle. Look for the next useful combination among the remaining pieces.

pages.title: Ultra Sharper
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Slice shapes to reach stars in Ultra Sharper. Use the mouse to cut a block and let the detached pieces move through the physics puzzle. Plan the angle so the falling sections can reach the required targets.

pages.title: Penguin Battle
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Protect an icy home in Penguin Battle. Use the mouse to aim and shoot at attacking penguins before they break through. Keep responding to the incoming enemies to hold the defense.

pages.title: Bottle Flip 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Flip a bottle through household scenery in Bottle Flip 3D. Use the mouse to time jumps between surfaces around the room. Judge the next landing point and keep the bottle's adventure moving across the objects.

pages.title: EG Tank Wars
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fight arcade armor battles in EG Tank Wars. Use terrain for cover, collect bonuses, and destroy opposing tanks. Pickups can improve weapons or alter the battlefield, including freezing water to make a crossing.

pages.title: Clash of Tanks
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Deploy units to destroy a rival stronghold in Clash of Tanks. Drag tank cards onto the field and choose vehicles whose strengths suit the situation. Balance the different types and timing of your deployments to overcome the enemy base.

pages.title: Oil Wrestling
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Outmaneuver a wrestler in Oil Wrestling. Make forward and sideways lunges to overpower the opponent and earn points. Play against the computer or share the keyboard with a second player, with the first to five points winning.

pages.title: Police Car Attack
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Escape head-on traffic in Police Car Attack. Drive around looping lanes in the opposite direction from the police and tap to change tracks. Keep finding a clear lane to avoid a crash and extend your survival time.

pages.title: Russian Cars Coloring Book
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Choose one of six drawings in Russian Cars Coloring Book. Apply shades from twenty-four available colors and complete the car picture. Save the artwork or print it after finishing your palette choices.

pages.title: A Day In The Life Of Princess College
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose college outfits in A Day In The Life Of Princess College. Help the students decide what to wear from their available wardrobes. Combine the clothing pieces into a separate finished look for each princess.

pages.title: Cute Puppy Rescue
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help Barbara care for an injured dog in Cute Puppy Rescue. Work through the puppy's treatment and care activities after she finds it wounded. Use mouse or touch controls to help prepare the adopted pet for its new home.

pages.title: BFFS Day of the Dead
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Prepare Elsa and Ariel for a different celebration in BFFS Day of the Dead. Join their Mexican friends and choose festive looks for the multi-day holiday. Combine the available clothing and styling details before the outing.

pages.title: Green Lake
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Fish in different waters in Green Lake. Cast for small and large catches and try to gather as many fish as possible. Use improvements such as rods, lures, and new fishing locations to continue developing your equipment and opportunities.

pages.title: Air Fight
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Take a warplane into combat in Air Fight. Pilot through aerial battles and shoot at enemy aircraft while trying to stay in the sky. Use mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to guide the plane and increase your takedown total.

pages.title: Final Night Zombie Street Fight
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Battle undead opponents in Final Night Zombie Street Fight. Punch, kick, defend, and jump through more than twenty levels across five locations. Pick up a knife, bat, or gun when available to add another option to the street fighting.

pages.title: Speed Car Racer
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Keep a sports car clear of traffic in Speed Car Racer. Steer around opposing vehicles and stay on the road for as long as possible. Each collision costs a life, so look ahead for space before passing the next car.

pages.title: Sliding Bricks
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Fit a moving piece to matching colors in Sliding Bricks. Tap to shift the brick left or right and clear lines through identical blocks. Keep removing rows so the formation cannot rise to the top of the screen.

pages.title: Stick City
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Gather stolen money in Stick City. Move around the streets collecting cash while avoiding police pursuit and passing cars. Watch both the officers and traffic as you try to keep the run going.

pages.title: Princess Easter Egg Decoration
pages.creator: GAMEGOS
pages.description: Help Tiana handle seasonal orders in Princess Easter Egg Decoration. Prepare egg-shaped cakes for her busy restaurant and complete their Easter decorations. Follow the baking activities to get the desserts ready for customers.

pages.title: Sudoku Hawaii
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Complete tropical number puzzles in Sudoku Hawaii. Fill the blank squares so each row, column, and smaller box contains every required digit once. Use the existing clues to work out the next safe placement.

pages.title: ICE QUEEN FLOWERS FESTIVAL
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Prepare Elsa for spring in ICE QUEEN FLOWERS FESTIVAL. Choose makeup, clothes, and accessories that suit the flower celebration. Mix the available colors into a bright festival look for the ice queen.

pages.title: Princess Sisters Special Day!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Decorate a Thanksgiving dessert in Princess Sisters Special Day! Help the royal sisters choose cake flavors, cream, and sweet toppings. Finish the celebration by arranging food and decorations on the table.
